changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'IsExternallyCalculated' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'metrics.Allocation')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.Allocation ADD IsExternallyCalculated [bit] not null CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_IsExternallyCalculated DEFAULT(0) END
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS DF_MetricAllocation_IsExternallyCalculated ALTER TABLE metrics.Allocation DROP COLUMN IF exists IsExternallyCalculated
